aircraft_catapult.source_note: Official USS Iowa photo 80-G-K-6118 shows an aircraft catapult, the stern crane, and an OS2U on its cart. The 28 December 1944 aerial photo 80-G-421124 checks the dated stern arrangement. The 1944 Iowa launch photo shows both catapults aligned in one launch direction; a veteran-association account describes rotating the port catapult to match the starboard heading. Track length is an approximately 60-foot visual estimate, not a measured Iowa plan dimension. Other dimensions, member sections, station centers, and stored headings remain visual estimates.

aircraft_crane.source_note: The single centerline stern crane and aircraft-hoisting arrangement are checked against official USS Iowa photo 80-G-K-6118 and 1944 USS Missouri photo 80-G-K-4561. These photos establish general appearance, not engineering dimensions. All dimensions and member sections remain visual estimates.
